title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where a birth 'crest' fixes a mage's aptitude, the greatest sage of his age reincarnates thousands of years later to gain the combat crest he always wanted. Reborn as Mathias Hildesheimr, third son of a duke, he finds that magic knowledge has collapsed and his crest is now scorned as the worst. At the Second Royal Academy he shatters prejudices with his skill and uncovers dark forces threatening a weakened humanity (Wikipedia; Square Enix blurb). Manga adaptation of a light novel.
life_message: Skill and knowledge, not the label you are born with, decide what you can do.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Ignores academy assumptions and acts on his own plan.

folkways.japan: A typical 'narou' isekai-style power fantasy with academy life and noble houses drawn from Japanese web-novel conventions.
